name: @frontal-labs/pr-describe
description: Drafts PR descriptions and change records from the diff, and turns them into changelogs.

scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:action
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --format esm
scripts.build:action: bun build src/action.ts --outfile dist/action.js --target node --format esm
